query: INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, status, priority, due_date) SELECT 'Task ' || n, CASE WHEN n % 2 = 0 THEN 'Description ' || n END, (ARRAY['todo', 'in_progress', 'done'])[n % 3 + 1], (ARRAY['low', 'medium', 'high'])[(n / 3) % 3 + 1], CASE WHEN (n / 9) % 3 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATE '2026-01-01' + (n % 365) END FROM generate_series(1, $1::int4) AS n
